title: The Second Time Platzi Applied to Y Combinator
conflicts: Founding and rename dates disagree (Wikipedia 2011/2014; BBC c.2012 and rename 2014; ENTER.CO rename early 2015); the story avoids a founding year and ties the rename to the YC period. YC acceptance: December 2014 (El CEO) vs January 2015 (ENTER.CO, Las2orillas); story says winter 2015 batch beginning January. Revenue $2.7M to date (TechCrunch, TNW 2015) vs US$3M a year later (2018); the 2015 figure is used. El País 2016 says all content Spanish while TNW 2015 says most was; the story does not claim English ended.
notes: Slate year 2014 moved to 2015 (YC W15). The first YC rejection rests on Crossing Borders show notes of Van der Henst's account (undated). Spanish-language sources are paraphrased; only English quotations from TechCrunch and TNW are quoted. Funding marked bootstrapped (no outside money before YC; venture-backed afterwards).
